scheme_name: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Diploma)
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The applicant must be a girl student.
The applicant must be pursuing the first year of the diploma course or the second year through lateral entry.
A maximum of two girl children per family are eligible to avail the scholarship.
The scholarship amount is provided for up to three years for first‑year entrants and up to two years for second‑year lateral entry entrants.
The family’s annual income must not exceed ₹8,00,000.
Eligibility requires submission of an online scholarship form.
benefits_summary: ₹50,000 per annum as a lump‑sum amount for up to 3 years for first‑year entrants or up to 2 years for second‑year lateral entry entrants.
